child_briefs.scope: Extend HuntStateMachine with new PHASES and wire session_gate.gate_transition to use the pure qualify, confidence, novelty, readiness, and human approval gates. Extend SessionApi and MCP surface to expose the new phases.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not modify the existing HuntStateMachine or weaken existing gates; extend additively.
child_briefs.inputs: Existing NobleGreedv2 HuntStateMachine, SessionApi, and gate_transition. Consumes all pure gate functions from siblings.
child_briefs.deliverables: Wiring of the FSM and SessionApi with the new gates. Exposes extended HuntStateMachine and SessionApi.
child_briefs.interfaces: wires all FSM gates and exposes the extended HuntStateMachine

child_briefs.title: Grounding and Confidence Gate
child_briefs.scope: Build a pure compute_confidence(finding, signals) function. Signals: pattern/semgrep match, FP-filter verdict, symbolic/AST-constraint check, taint-flow proof, formal-path proof. Rules: single tool match => MEDIUM; cross-validated independent agreement + clean FP-filter => HIGH; structural taint-flow/formal-path proof OR confirmed live PoC => CONFIRMED; known-FP match => LOW. Transition admits only CONFIRMED/HIGH; MEDIUM to review holding; LOW recorded and dropped. No silent drops, log tier + signals.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not implement real static analysis / proof / semgrep / joern / codeql runners.
child_briefs.inputs: Existing NobleGreedv2 contracts, legacy logic from /home/xnihil0zer0/AI-Data/NobleGreed-legacy/services/code_audit/grounding.py.
child_briefs.deliverables: A pure confidence calculation module with a committed oracle. Exposes compute_confidence(finding: dict, signals: list) -> str.

child_briefs.title: Human Checkpoint Gate
child_briefs.scope: FSM parks package in awaiting_submission, advances to submitted via injected human-approval seam (decision-file gate). Persists submission record (target, CWE, severity, payout-estimate, novelty, evidence, approval, timestamp) to a ledger.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not implement the real UI or automate the actual platform submission.
child_briefs.inputs: Existing NobleGreedv2 contracts, ngv2.session_db.SessionDB. Exposes readiness(finding: dict, poc: dict, live_report: dict, novelty: str, bounty: dict) -> dict from ngv2_fsm_readiness_gate.
child_briefs.deliverables: A pure approval checkpoint function and persistence logic. Exposes check_human_approval(decision_filepath: str) -> bool and persist_submission(record: dict, now_fn: callable) -> None.
child_briefs.interfaces: check_human_approval(decision_filepath: str) -> bool and persist_submission(record: dict, now_fn: callable) -> None

child_briefs.title: Novelty and Duplication Gate
child_briefs.scope: Build a pure classify_novelty(finding, known_corpus) over prior submissions/advisories. Returns NOVEL / POSSIBLE_DUP / CONFIRMED_DUP (matching title + CWE + file-locus). Only NOVEL (or operator-overridden POSSIBLE_DUP) advances; CONFIRMED_DUP terminates.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not implement real corpus database connections, network requests, or platform API calls.
child_briefs.inputs: Existing NobleGreedv2 contracts, legacy logic from /home/xnihil0zer0/AI-Data/NobleGreed-legacy/services/code_audit/novelty_checker.py.
child_briefs.deliverables: A pure novelty classification module with a committed oracle. Exposes classify_novelty(finding: dict, known_corpus: list) -> str.

child_briefs.title: Submission Readiness Gate
child_briefs.scope: Build a pure readiness(finding, poc, live_report, novelty, bounty) function. Admits package only when: confidence is CONFIRMED/HIGH, live_tested PoC is 'confirmed', novelty is NOVEL, target is bounty-eligible, package is complete (readiness_score == 3). Otherwise halts and names the missing artifact.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not interact with live platforms or systems.
child_briefs.inputs: Existing NobleGreedv2 contracts, legacy logic from /home/xnihil0zer0/AI-Data/NobleGreed-legacy/services/mcp_server.py and services/submission_scorer.py. Exposes compute_confidence(finding: dict, signals: list) -> str from ngv2_fsm_grounding_confidence_gate and classify_novelty(finding: dict, known_corpus: list) -> str from ngv2_fsm_novelty_gate.
child_briefs.deliverables: A pure readiness checking module with a committed oracle. Exposes readiness(finding: dict, poc: dict, live_report: dict, novelty: str, bounty: dict) -> dict.
child_briefs.interfaces: readiness(finding: dict, poc: dict, live_report: dict, novelty: str, bounty: dict) -> dict

child_briefs.title: Bounty Sourcing and Qualification Gate
child_briefs.scope: Build a pure qualify(target, oracle_result) function and its bounty_oracle seam. Admitting criteria: expected_payout > 0, open_submissions < saturation_cap, days_since_audit >= freshness_min, and no false-positive-risk match. Matches legacy bounty_gate.py + qualify_target.py (GO/SKIP/UNKNOWN). Outputs qualified target_spec.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do not implement the real side-effecting bounty-platform client, network, or live API calls.
child_briefs.inputs: Existing NobleGreedv2 contracts, legacy logic from /home/xnihil0zer0/AI-Data/NobleGreed-legacy/services/bounty_gate.py and qualify_target.py.
child_briefs.deliverables: A pure qualification module with a committed non-vacuous oracle. Exposes qualify(target: dict, oracle_result: dict) -> dict.

child_briefs.title: Submission Package Builder
child_briefs.scope: Extend the existing report build into a platform-shaped SUBMISSION PACKAGE containing: title, CWE, severity, vulnerable code refs, attack scenario, PoC reference, live-test evidence, impact, suggested fix, using the submission report template.

child_briefs.title: Human-checkpoint approval gate (awaiting_submission -> submitted -> done): the single human decision + ledger record
child_briefs.scope: Build a pure, stdlib+ngv2-only module ngv2/human_approval_gate.py realizing the awaiting_submission -> submitted -> done stage — the SINGLE human checkpoint of the entire lifecycle. A fully-assembled, turn-in-ready package is parked in awaiting_submission; the gate advances to submitted ONLY through an INJECTED human-approval seam (an operator decision, analogous to JanusMaskJR's decision-file gate). On approval it records the outcome as a ledger row; submitted -> done is terminal and persists the submission record (target, CWE, severity, payout-estimate, novelty, evidence, approval, timestamp via injected now_fn). On non-approval / no-decision it remains parked (no advance, no silent submit). Pure and deterministic over the injected approval-seam result and now_fn. Ship a hand-authored RED oracle covering approve (advance + ledger row), reject/hold (stay parked), and absent decision.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do NOT automate the actual turn-in to any live bounty platform — the human performs that act; this gate stops at recording an approved, turn-in-ready package. Do NOT implement the human-approval adapter itself (the operator decision-file / decision seam is owner-hand-authored and injected). No network, no live platform calls, no credentials, no wall-clock (use injected now_fn), no randomness, no subprocess. Do not auto-approve. Do not build the package (consume ngv2_submission_package_builder).
child_briefs.inputs: Consumes ngv2.contracts, the injected-seam adapter pattern from ngv2.poc_runner_live, and the package from ngv2_submission_package_builder `build_submission_package(...) -> dict` (platform-shaped package). Injected at runtime: a human-approval seam (callable returning an operator decision) and now_fn for the ledger timestamp.
child_briefs.deliverables: ngv2/human_approval_gate.py exposing `approve_submission(package: dict, approval_seam) -> dict` returning {"outcome": "submitted"|"parked", "decision": dict} advancing only on operator approval, and `record_submission(package: dict, decision: dict, *, now_fn) -> dict` returning a ledger row (target, cwe, severity, payout_estimate, novelty, evidence, approval, timestamp). Plus a committed RED oracle test.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes `approve_submission(package: dict, approval_seam) -> dict` ({"outcome":"submitted"|"parked","decision":dict}; advances only on injected operator approval) and `record_submission(package: dict, decision: dict, *, now_fn) -> dict` (ledger row).

child_briefs.title: Extended PHASES / ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS + session_gate evidence gates wiring the full autonomous lifecycle
child_briefs.scope: Additively extend the existing HuntStateMachine spine to expose the full ordered phase set source -> hunt -> triage -> verify -> poc -> detonate -> novelty -> report -> awaiting_submission -> submitted -> done, with a deterministic EVIDENCE gate on every transition. Extend PHASES and ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS and wire ngv2.session_gate.gate_transition so each transition invokes the corresponding pure gate: source->hunt uses qualify(); triage->verify uses compute_confidence()+route_confidence() (admit CONFIRMED/HIGH, MEDIUM->manual-review holding state, LOW->FP-evidence drop); verify->poc->detonate uses existing PoC build + ngv2.detonation.semantic_verdict (require 'confirmed' = exit 0 AND success marker AND expected filesystem-signature in the live fs diff; marker-spoofing alone must NOT confirm); detonate->novelty uses classify_novelty()+route_novelty(); novelty->report uses build_submission_package(); report->awaiting_submission uses readiness(); awaiting_submission->submitted uses approve_submission(); submitted->done uses record_submission(). Pure/deterministic — all non-determinism stays in the injected gate seams. Ship a hand-authored RED oracle that, over mock/scripted seams, deterministically carries one qualified target all the way to a turn-in-ready package, HALTS at awaiting_submission pending the injected human approval, then records the submission on approval — and asserts no built code touches network/clock/randomness/subprocess/live-platform.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do NOT rewrite or replace the existing HuntStateMachine — extend it additively. Do NOT re-implement the pure gates (import and call the sibling modules). Do NOT weaken any existing acceptance gate, especially the strengthened detonation semantic verdict. Do NOT implement any seam adapter (bounty oracle, scanners, LLM hunt worker, live runner, approval seam) — all injected. No network, wall-clock, randomness, real subprocess, or live platform action in any built code. Do not author full integration/e2e harnesses beyond the wiring's own RED oracle. Do not build the SessionApi/MCP surface (that is ngv2_session_api_surface).
child_briefs.inputs: Reuse ngv2.state_machine.HuntStateMachine + PHASES, ngv2.session_gate.gate_transition, ngv2.session_db.SessionDB, ngv2.contracts, ngv2.fp_filter.filter_findings, ngv2.dedup.filter_new, ngv2.pattern_scanner, ngv2.detonation.semantic_verdict + DetonationChamber (AFTER prerequisite brief ngv2_fix_detonation_semantic_gate lands), and the existing hunt finders/poc_builder/live-runner injected seams. Consumes the sibling gate functions: ngv2_source_qualify_gate `qualify(target, oracle_result, *, saturation_cap, freshness_min, fp_risk_filter) -> dict`; ngv2_grounding_confidence_gate `compute_confidence(finding, signals: dict) -> str` and `route_confidence(tier: str) -> dict`; ngv2_novelty_gate `classify_novelty(finding, known_corpus: list) -> str` and `route_novelty(verdict, operator_override=False) -> dict`; ngv2_submission_package_builder `build_submission_package(...) -> dict` and `readiness_score(package: dict) -> int`; ngv2_submission_readiness_gate `readiness(...) -> dict` ({"ready": bool, "missing": str|None}); ngv2_human_approval_gate `approve_submission(package, approval_seam) -> dict` and `record_submission(package, decision, *, now_fn) -> dict`. NOTE: prerequisite fix briefs ngv2_fix_classify_phase and ngv2_fix_detonation_semantic_gate must already be landed (external prerequisites, not siblings).
child_briefs.deliverables: Additive extension to ngv2.state_machine PHASES and ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS covering source->hunt->triage->verify->poc->detonate->novelty->report->awaiting_submission->submitted->done, and ngv2.session_gate.gate_transition evidence-gate dispatch invoking each pure sibling gate with the stated routing (CONFIRMED/HIGH advance, MEDIUM->manual_review, LOW->drop; detonate requires semantic_verdict 'confirmed'; only NOVEL advances; readiness must be ready; submitted only via approval seam). Plus a committed RED oracle driving the full happy path to the awaiting_submission halt and through approval.
child_briefs.interfaces: extends ngv2.state_machine PHASES to ('source','hunt','triage','verify','poc','detonate','novelty','report','awaiting_submission','submitted','done') with ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS one-step ordered, and ngv2.session_gate.gate_transition(phase_from, phase_to, evidence) admitting each transition only on its sibling gate's verdict.

child_briefs.title: SessionApi / MCP surface extension exposing the new lifecycle phases and transitions
child_briefs.scope: Additively extend ngv2.session_api.SessionApi (and its MCP surface) to expose the new lifecycle phases and transitions wired by ngv2_lifecycle_fsm_wiring: the full ordered phase set source -> hunt -> triage -> verify -> poc -> detonate -> novelty -> report -> awaiting_submission -> submitted -> done, including the manual-review holding state for MEDIUM-tier findings and the awaiting_submission parked state. Expose read/advance operations so an operator/agent can observe the current phase, the parked turn-in-ready package, and the not-ready 'missing artifact' reason, and can drive autonomous transitions while the awaiting_submission -> submitted step remains gated behind the injected human-approval seam. Pure/deterministic over injected seams (SessionApi._classify after the ngv2_fix_classify_phase fix). Ship a hand-authored RED oracle asserting the surface reports the new phases and exposes the awaiting_submission halt + approval transition without performing any side effect.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do NOT define the FSM transitions or evidence gates (consume ngv2_lifecycle_fsm_wiring). Do NOT implement any seam adapter or auto-approve submissions. Do NOT automate the live turn-in. No network, wall-clock, randomness, real subprocess, or live platform action. Do not rewrite SessionApi — extend it additively and do not weaken any existing gate.
child_briefs.inputs: Reuse ngv2.session_api.SessionApi and its _classify (AFTER prerequisite brief ngv2_fix_classify_phase lands), ngv2.session_db.SessionDB, ngv2.contracts. Consumes the extended FSM from ngv2_lifecycle_fsm_wiring: ngv2.state_machine PHASES = ('source','hunt','triage','verify','poc','detonate','novelty','report','awaiting_submission','submitted','done') with ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS one-step ordered, and ngv2.session_gate.gate_transition(phase_from, phase_to, evidence) admitting each transition only on its gate's verdict. NOTE: ngv2_fix_classify_phase is an external prerequisite, not a sibling.
child_briefs.deliverables: Additive extension to ngv2.session_api.SessionApi / MCP surface exposing the new phases (including manual_review holding and awaiting_submission parked states) with operations to read current phase, inspect the parked submission package, read the readiness 'missing artifact' reason, and request autonomous transitions — with awaiting_submission->submitted surfaced as the single human-gated step. Plus a committed RED oracle test.
child_briefs.interfaces: SessionApi reports and drives the full ordered phase set source->...->done (plus manual_review holding state); awaiting_submission->submitted is exposed as the single human-approval-gated transition; reads expose the parked package and the not-ready missing-artifact reason.

child_briefs.title: Submission-readiness gate (report -> awaiting_submission): pure readiness() admitting only fully-grounded packages
child_briefs.scope: Build a pure, stdlib+ngv2-only module ngv2/submission_readiness_gate.py realizing the report -> awaiting_submission SUBMISSION-READINESS gate. Port the BEHAVIOR of the legacy services/mcp_server.py submit_finding gates (dedup, bounty-eligibility, live-tested, readiness). A pure readiness(finding, poc, live_report, novelty, bounty, package) admits a package to the human ONLY when ALL hold: confidence in {CONFIRMED, HIGH}; a live_tested PoC with verdict 'confirmed'; novelty == NOVEL; bounty-eligible target; report package complete (readiness_score == 3). Anything short HALTS in a not-ready state naming EXACTLY the missing artifact (no generic failure). Deterministic and total. Ship a hand-authored RED oracle: one all-pass case plus one case per failing precondition, each asserting the named missing artifact.
child_briefs.non_goals: Do NOT build the submission package or its completeness score (consume ngv2_submission_package_builder). Do NOT compute confidence or novelty (consume the upstream gates). Do NOT perform the human approval or any submission (that is ngv2_human_approval_gate). No network, subprocess, LLM, wall-clock, or randomness. Do not wire the FSM transition (that is ngv2_lifecycle_fsm_wiring). Do not weaken any precondition.
child_briefs.inputs: Consumes ngv2.contracts (Finding/PoC/LiveTestReport, VERDICTS) and legacy services/mcp_server.py submit_finding gate behavior. Consumes the confidence tier from ngv2_grounding_confidence_gate `compute_confidence(finding, signals: dict) -> str` returning "CONFIRMED"|"HIGH"|"MEDIUM"|"LOW"; the novelty verdict from ngv2_novelty_gate `classify_novelty(finding, known_corpus: list) -> str` returning "NOVEL"|"POSSIBLE_DUP"|"CONFIRMED_DUP"; the bounty-eligibility/qualified target_spec from ngv2_source_qualify_gate `qualify(...) -> dict` ({"decision":"GO"|"SKIP"|"UNKNOWN",...,"target_spec":dict|None}); and the package + score from ngv2_submission_package_builder `build_submission_package(...) -> dict` and `readiness_score(package: dict) -> int` in 0..3.
child_briefs.deliverables: ngv2/submission_readiness_gate.py exposing `readiness(finding, poc, live_report, novelty: str, bounty: dict, package: dict, confidence: str) -> dict` returning {"ready": bool, "missing": str|None} where ready==True iff confidence in {CONFIRMED,HIGH} AND live_report verdict=='confirmed' AND novelty=='NOVEL' AND bounty-eligible AND readiness_score(package)==3; otherwise ready==False and missing names exactly the failing artifact. Plus a committed RED oracle test.
child_briefs.interfaces: exposes `readiness(finding, poc, live_report, novelty: str, bounty: dict, package: dict, confidence: str) -> dict` returning {"ready": bool, "missing": str|None}; ready iff confidence in {CONFIRMED,HIGH} AND live verdict 'confirmed' AND novelty=='NOVEL' AND bounty-eligible AND readiness_score==3.
